name: Minimal text input to one-shot standalone H3 prompt
prompt: Make me a 6 second MiniMax H3 video prompt of a cyberpunk rain chase and add one line of dialogue.

judge.check: The agent produces a complete standalone MiniMax H3 prompt without exposing internal preset names or asking unnecessary questions.
The prompt passes validate_h3_prompt.py with contiguous 00.00s-06.00s timestamps, zero media tags, valid (S1) <d>[Language] ...</d> syntax, and no placeholders.
Minimal user input is expanded into continuous camera motion, concrete physical actions, non-musical [SOUNDS], overall_soundscape, and non_diegetic_music.
